forum.title: Wrong (?) description of ADCs in STM32H5E5/F5
forum.best_answer_content: Issue internally confirmed and removed from all STM32H5 products (if it was the case) but the update will be effective on st.com within few hours (after system synchronization) / tomorrow at the latest.
